problem: Calculate the circulation $\Gamma$ of the vector field $F(x,y)=\frac{3}{y}\,i-\frac{2}{x}\,j$ along the ellipse $C$ with equation $9x^2+4y^2=36$, oriented counterclockwise. Interpret circulation here as the sum of the four convergent improper line integrals on the open quadrant arcs, taking the one-sided limits independently at each axis intersection. The field is undefined at $(\pm2,0)$ and $(0,\pm3)$; ordinary circulation on the entire closed ellipse is not defined as stated in the original source.
